result.summary: The interface presents a few minor polish and accessibility concerns regarding contrast and visual assets.

issues.description: White text on the light green promotional banner has insufficient contrast, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text weight or use a significantly darker color for the promotional message.

issues.description: The app uses generic vector illustrations instead of actual food photography, which reduces visual quality.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder illustrations with high-quality restaurant-specific photos.

issues.description: Restaurant names in horizontal carousels are truncated abruptly, which looks unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text wrapping or provide more horizontal space for restaurant titles.
